title: Geologic map of the Gadsden quadrangle, Calhoun and Richland Counties, South Carolina
citation: Shelley, D.C., 2007, Geologic map of the Gadsden quadrangle, Calhoun and Richland Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-37, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face and the references column are partly mixed in the OCR. Section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 40, sea level, feet and meters) read from page images: 27 holes. Solid holes (<0.5 km from the line per the section note) have units and elevations read off the section's own scale (inferred); dashed holes (0.5-2 km, picks secondary) get only top elevation and drawn length. Two coincident holes labelled 40-188 and 40-191 were skipped because the labels cannot be matched to the two lines. Terrace symbols Qt6 and Qt8 are used as drawn on the section; the terrace complex units Qt0-Qt13 are only partly legible in the OCR and not recorded individually. Geotechnical site identifiers in the symbol explanation are not recorded. OCR misreads: 'Creck' read as Creek, 'KsI' as Ksl, 'Te garee' as Congaree. SUBSURFACE: the floodplain's suballuvial surface has up to 15 feet of local relief (stated); no contour values.
